## Overview

This vignette demonstrates a complete imprintomeR workflow on **GSE240091**, a public DNA methylation dataset of growing teratoma tissues. Samples are subgrouped by reported growth speed: slow, medium, and rapid. You will:

1. **Download** GEO metadata and processed beta values
2. **Prepare** raw IDAT metadata for the MethQcSet QC workflow
3. **Run** methylation-array QC when IDAT files are available
4. **Create** an ImprintomeSet object from QC-clean or processed data
5. **Analyze** imprinting status and visualize results
6. **Export** QC and imprintomeR outputs

GSE240091 uses the Illumina Infinium HumanMethylationEPIC BeadChip (850K/GPL23976). The GEO record includes 12 samples and a raw IDAT archive. The processed-beta route is attempted first when GEO provides matrix values; the raw-IDAT route shows the full QC workflow and is intended for local execution after downloading the supplementary tar file.

---

## Phase 1: Setup & GEO Download

### Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(imprintomeR)

if (!requireNamespace("GEOquery", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("GEOquery is required for GEO downloads. Install it with: BiocManager::install(\"GEOquery\")", call. = FALSE)
}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

set.seed(2026)
```

### Download GSE240091 metadata and processed values

```{r download-gse240091, eval = TRUE, cache = TRUE}
geo_gse <- "GSE240091"
message("Downloading ", geo_gse, " from GEO...")

tryCatch({
  gse <- GEOquery::getGEO(geo_gse, GSEMatrix = TRUE, AnnotGPL = FALSE, getGPL = FALSE)
  eset <- gse[[1]]

  message("Download successful")
  message("  Samples: ", ncol(eset))
  message("  Features: ", nrow(eset))
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("Failed to download ", geo_gse, ":\n", conditionMessage(e),
       "\nCheck internet connection and GEO availability.")
})
```

### Extract metadata

```{r extract-metadata}
pdata <- pData(eset)

message("Available metadata columns:")
print(colnames(pdata))

message("\nSample overview:")
display_cols <- intersect(
  c("geo_accession", "title", "source_name_ch1", "characteristics_ch1"),
  colnames(pdata)
)
head(pdata[, display_cols, drop = FALSE], n = 6)
```

### Build sample metadata

```{r build-meta}
sample_title <- if ("title" %in% colnames(pdata)) pdata$title else pdata$geo_accession

# Keep GEO columns that are often useful during interpretation.
optional_cols <- intersect(
  c("source_name_ch1", "characteristics_ch1", "characteristics_ch1.1",
    "characteristics_ch1.2", "characteristics_ch1.3"),
  colnames(pdata)
)

metadata_text <- apply(
  pdata[, intersect(c("title", optional_cols), colnames(pdata)), drop = FALSE],
  1,
  function(z) paste(z, collapse = " ")
)

meta <- data.frame(
  Sample_Name = pdata$geo_accession,
  GEO_Accession = pdata$geo_accession,
  Sample_Title = sample_title,
  Sample_Group = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("slow", metadata_text, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GTSslow",
    grepl("medium|mediu[mn]", metadata_text, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GTSmedium",
    grepl("rapid", metadata_text, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GTSrapid",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ),
  Platform = "EPIC",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta <- cbind(meta, pdata[, optional_cols, drop = FALSE])

message("Metadata created:")
message("  Samples: ", nrow(meta))
print(table(meta$Sample_Group))
head(meta, n = 6)
```

---

## Phase 2: Raw IDAT QC Workflow

The raw IDAT archive for GSE240091 is large, so this section is set to `eval = FALSE`. Run it locally when you want full preprocessing and QC from raw array files.

### Download and unpack supplementary IDAT files

```{r download-raw-idat, eval = FALSE}
raw_dir <- file.path("GSE240091_raw")
dir.create(raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Downloads GSE240091_RAW.tar from GEO.
supp <- GEOquery::getGEOSuppFiles(geo_gse, makeDirectory = TRUE, baseDir = raw_dir)
print(supp)

tar_file <- rownames(supp)[grepl("RAW\\.tar$", rownames(supp))]
untar(tar_file, exdir = file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse))

# GEO IDAT archives are commonly gzipped inside the tar.
gz_idats <- list.files(
  file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),
  pattern = "\\.idat\\.gz$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(gz_idats) > 0 && requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE)) {
  lapply(gz_idats, R.utils::gunzip, overwrite = TRUE, remove = TRUE)
}

# minfi expects channel suffixes named _Red.idat and _Grn.idat.
# GSE240091 raw files may unpack as lowercase _red.idat and _green.idat.
lowercase_idats <- list.files(
  file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),
  pattern = "_(red|green)\\.idat$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

for (old_file in lowercase_idats) {
  new_file <- sub("_red\\.idat$", "_Red.idat", old_file)
  new_file <- sub("_green\\.idat$", "_Grn.idat", new_file)
  if (!identical(old_file, new_file)) {
    file.rename(old_file, new_file)
  }
}
```

### Create QC-ready metadata with Basename paths

`runMethQC()` expects a `Basename` column containing the IDAT path prefix without `_Red.idat` or `_Grn.idat`.

```{r make-idat-meta, eval = FALSE}
idat_files <- list.files(
  file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),
  pattern = "_(Red|Grn)\\.idat$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# idat_prefixes <- unique(sub("_(red|green)\\.idat(\\.gz)?$", "", idat_files))
idat_prefixes <- unique(sub("_(Red|Grn)\\.idat$", "", idat_files))
idat_base <- basename(idat_prefixes)
idat_map <- data.frame(
  Basename = idat_prefixes,
  GEO_Accession = sub("_.*$", "", idat_base),
  IDAT_Sample_Title = sub("^GSM[0-9]+_?", "", idat_base),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# GEO raw files usually start with GSM accessions. Join by GSM first and keep
# the title-derived name as a readable sample label for QC reports.
meta_qc <- meta %>%
  left_join(idat_map, by = "GEO_Accession") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_Name = paste(GEO_Accession, "_", IDAT_Sample_Title),
    Sample_Group = Sample_Group,
    Platform = "EPIC"
  )

meta_qc <- meta_qc[, c("Sample_Name", "Sample_Group", "Platform", "Basename")]
head(meta_qc)

```

### Install Bioconductor dependencies if needed

This chunk is disabled by default because it can modify your R library. Enable it when running the raw-IDAT QC workflow in a fresh R or HPC environment. It also refreshes the `minfi`/`matrixStats` stack to avoid the `useNames = NA is defunct` error from incompatible package versions.

```{r install-bioc-dependencies, eval = FALSE}
required_bioc <- c(
  "minfi",
  "GEOquery",
  "annotate",
  "matrixStats",
  "MatrixGenerics",
  "DelayedMatrixStats",
  "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICmanifest"
)

missing_bioc <- required_bioc[!vapply(required_bioc, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

if (length(missing_bioc) > 0) {
  BiocManager::install(missing_bioc, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}

# Refresh the packages involved in minfi::detectionP(). This fixes environments
# where an older minfi stack calls matrixStats with the now-defunct useNames = NA.
BiocManager::install(
  c("minfi", "matrixStats", "MatrixGenerics", "DelayedMatrixStats"),
  ask = FALSE,
  update = TRUE
)
```

### Run MethQcSet QC

```{r run-meth-qc, eval = FALSE, cache = TRUE}
library(imprintomeR)
library(minfi)

qcset <- runMethQC(
  meta_qc,
  platform = "EPIC",
  pcutoff = 0.05
)

qc_summary <- qc_summarize(qcset)
str(qc_summary)

qc_matrix <- qc_tables(qcset)[["QC_matrix"]]
message("QC status:")
print(table(qc_matrix$Final.QC))

head(qc_matrix)
```

### QC visualizations

```{r qc-plots, eval = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
p_qc_bar <- plot(qcset, type = "qc_bar", outFile = NULL)
print(p_qc_bar)

p_qc_intensity <- plot(qcset, type = "intensity", icutoff = 11, outFile = NULL)
print(p_qc_intensity)

p_qc_detection <- plot(qcset, type = "detection_pval", pcutoff = 0.05, outFile = NULL)
print(p_qc_detection)

p_qc_coverage <- plot(qcset, type = "probe_coverage", outFile = NULL)
print(p_qc_coverage)

p_qc_sex <- plot(qcset, type = "predicted_sex", outFile = NULL)
print(p_qc_sex)
```

### Export QC outputs

```{r export-qc, eval = FALSE}
qc_outdir <- "GSE240091_qc_output"
dir.create(qc_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

export(
  qcset,
  outdir = qc_outdir,
  format = c("xlsx", "rds", "txt"),
  prefix = "GSE240091"
)

message("QC outputs exported to: ", qc_outdir)
```

## Phase 3: Prepare Beta Values for ImprintomeSet

### Use QC-clean beta values when available

If you ran the raw-IDAT QC workflow above, use PASS samples from `qcset`.

```{r beta-from-qc, eval = FALSE}
qc_matrix <- qc_tables(qcset)[["QC_matrix"]]
pass_samples <- qc_matrix$Sample_Name[qc_matrix$Final.QC == "PASS"]

qcset_pass <- qcset
beta(qcset_pass) <- beta(qcset)[, pass_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta(qcset_pass) <- meta(qcset)[meta(qcset)$Sample_Name %in% pass_samples, , drop = FALSE]

x <- as.ImprintomeSet(
  qcset_pass,
  probeset = readRDS(system.file("extdata", "probesets_hg19.rds", package = "imprintomeR"))[["selected"]],
  genome = "hg19"
)
```

### Processed-beta route from GEO

Use this route when you want to run the imprinting workflow directly from GEO processed beta values.

```{r extract-beta}
beta_matrix <- exprs(eset)

if (nrow(beta_matrix) == 0L) {
  stop("No processed beta matrix was found in the GEO Series Matrix object. ",
       "Run the raw IDAT QC workflow or inspect the GEO sample tables manually.")
}

storage.mode(beta_matrix) <- "numeric"
beta_matrix <- beta_matrix[rowSums(!is.na(beta_matrix)) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

message("Beta matrix dimensions: ", nrow(beta_matrix), " probes x ",
        ncol(beta_matrix), " samples")
message("Beta range: [", round(min(beta_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 3), ", ",
        round(max(beta_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "]")

# Align GEO accession sample IDs between beta and metadata.
meta_processed <- meta %>%
  filter(Sample_Name %in% colnames(beta_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample_Name, colnames(beta_matrix)))
beta_matrix <- beta_matrix[, meta_processed$Sample_Name, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(beta_matrix), meta_processed$Sample_Name))
```

### Validate processed data

```{r validate-data}
pct_missing <- colSums(is.na(beta_matrix)) / nrow(beta_matrix) * 100
message("Missing beta values per sample:")
print(head(sort(pct_missing, decreasing = TRUE), n = 10))

message("Sample names aligned: ", identical(colnames(beta_matrix), meta_processed$Sample_Name))
print(table(meta_processed$Sample_Group))
```

## Phase 4: Create ImprintomeSet

### Load data using imprintomeR utilities

```{r load-metabeta}
beta_df <- as.data.frame(beta_matrix)
beta_df <- cbind(NAME = rownames(beta_df), beta_df)

input <- LoadMetaBeta(meta_processed, beta_df, probeset = NULL)

message("Loaded data:")
message("  Samples: ", ncol(input$beta))
message("  Probes:  ", nrow(input$beta))
message("  Metadata columns: ", paste(colnames(input$meta), collapse = ", "))
```

### Create the analysis-ready object

```{r create-imprintomeset}
probesets <- readRDS(
  system.file("extdata", "probesets_hg19.rds", package = "imprintomeR")
)

x <- ImprintomeSet(
  beta = input$beta,
  meta = input$meta,
  probeset = probesets[["selected"]],
  genome = "hg19",
  assay = "EPIC"
)

message("ImprintomeSet created:")
message("  Samples: ", ncol(beta(x)))
message("  Probes:  ", nrow(beta(x)))
message("  Genome:  ", genome(x))
message("  Assay:   ", assay(x))
print(summary(x))
```

---

## Phase 5: Run Workflow & Compute Statistics

### Execute imprintomeR analysis

```{r run-imprintome}
message("Running imprintome analysis...")
x <- runImprintome(x, probeset = "selected", ids_cutoff = 0.2)
message("Analysis complete")

res <- results(x)
message("Results available:")
print(names(res))

status <- res[["AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected"]]
head(status, n = 5)
```

### Compute per-group statistics

```{r compute-stats}
message("Imprinting status by group:")
print(table(status[, c("Sample_Group", "Mechanism")]))

stat_summary <- status %>%
  group_by(Sample_Group, Mechanism) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    median_IDS = median(IDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Angle = median(Angle, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Group, desc(n))

stat_summary
```

### Review key metrics

```{r review-metrics}
message("IDS distribution:")
print(summary(status$IDS))

message("\nMechanism classification:")
print(table(status$Mechanism))

message("\nAngle distribution:")
print(summary(status$Angle))
```

## Phase 7: Results Interpretation

### Summary statistics

```{r interpret-summary}
normal_n <- sum(status$Mechanism == "NORMAL", na.rm = TRUE)
total_n <- nrow(status)
normal_pct <- normal_n / total_n * 100
abnormal_pct <- 100 - normal_pct

message("=== OVERALL IMPRINTING SUMMARY ===")
message(sprintf("Normal imprinting:   %6.1f%% (%d/%d samples)",
                normal_pct, normal_n, total_n))
message(sprintf("Altered imprinting:  %6.1f%% (%d/%d samples)",
                abnormal_pct, total_n - normal_n, total_n))

message("\n=== BY SAMPLE GROUP ===")
for (group in unique(status$Sample_Group)) {
  idx <- status$Sample_Group == group
  n <- sum(idx)
  normal <- sum(status$Mechanism[idx] == "NORMAL", na.rm = TRUE)
  message(sprintf("%12s: %d samples, %d normal (%.1f%%)",
                  group, n, normal, 100 * normal / n))
}
```

### Identify samples with aberrant imprinting

```{r identify-abnormal}
abnormal <- status %>% filter(Mechanism != "NORMAL")

if (nrow(abnormal) > 0) {
  message("=== ABERRANT IMPRINTING SAMPLES ===")
  message("Sample count: ", nrow(abnormal))
  print(abnormal %>% select(Sample_ID, Sample_Group, Mechanism, IDS, Angle) %>% head(n = 12))
} else {
  message("All samples show normal imprinting patterns by the selected IDS cutoff.")
}
```

### Growth-speed comparison

GSE240091 groups samples by growing teratoma growth speed. This block summarizes imprinting scores across slow, medium, and rapid groups.

```{r growth-speed-summary}
growth_summary <- status %>%
  group_by(Sample_Group) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    median_IDS = median(IDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_IDS = mean(IDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Angle = median(Angle, na.rm = TRUE),
    most_common_mechanism = names(sort(table(Mechanism), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Sample_Group, levels = c("GTSslow", "GTSmedium", "GTSrapid", "Other")))

detailed_status <- status %>%
  mutate(Sample_Title = meta(x)$Sample_Title[match(Sample_ID, meta(x)$Sample_Name)]) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Sample_Title, Sample_Group, Mechanism, IDS, Angle) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Group, desc(IDS))

growth_summary
head(detailed_status, n = 12)
```

## Phase 8: Export & Save Results

### Export ImprintomeSet outputs

```{r export-imprintome}
outdir <- "GSE240091_imprintome_output"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

manifest <- export(
  x,
  outdir = outdir,
  result_names = "AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected",
  save_plots = FALSE,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

manifest
```

### Export summary tables

```{r export-tables}
results_file <- file.path(outdir, "GSE240091_imprintome_results.txt")
write.table(
  status,
  file = results_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)

summary_file <- file.path(outdir, "GSE240091_summary_statistics.txt")
write.table(
  stat_summary,
  file = summary_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)

growth_file <- file.path(outdir, "GSE240091_growth_speed_summary.txt")
write.table(
  growth_summary,
  file = growth_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)

detail_file <- file.path(outdir, "GSE240091_detailed_status.txt")
write.table(
  detailed_status,
  file = detail_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)

message("Results table: ", results_file)
message("Summary statistics: ", summary_file)
message("Growth-speed summary: ", growth_file)
message("Detailed status: ", detail_file)
```

### List output files

```{r list-outputs}

for (f in sort(output_files)) {
```

## Jupyter Notebook Conversion Guide

This vignette is designed for conversion to Jupyter notebooks. To convert:

```bash
# 1. Render this Rmd to HTML (in R):
rmarkdown::render("vignettes/GSE240091.Rmd")

# 2. Convert HTML to Jupyter notebook:
jupyter nbconvert --to notebook GSE240091.html --output GSE240091.ipynb

# 3. Or use Jupytext to convert Rmd directly:
jupytext --to notebook vignettes/GSE240091.Rmd
```

**Tips for Jupyter users:**
- The raw-IDAT QC chunks are disabled by default; change `eval = FALSE` to `eval = TRUE` after downloading the raw archive.
- Use `cache = TRUE` on GEO and QC chunks to avoid repeated downloads and IDAT reads.
- Set `outFile` in plot calls to save publication-ready PDFs or PNGs.
- Keep QC and imprintome outputs in separate directories for easier review.
